table: band transmittance against horizontal range, LWIR 8-12 um and MWIR 3-5 um
source: SYNTHETIC: written by this repository (S3) to exercise the IR proxy's plumbing; it is NOT an atmosphere, not a MODTRAN or libRadtran output, and no number read off an image made with it describes any real path

generator.formula: tau = exp(-k R), R in km
generator.note: a Beer-Lambert shape with declared, invented extinction coefficients; not Koschmieder (no visibility enters), not fitted to anything

path: none (synthetic): the proxy applies it to every pixel's range as if horizontal and uniform
real_table_step: run MODTRAN 6 (licensed) or libRadtran's uvspec with a stated model atmosphere, aerosol, altitude and path geometry, band-average the transmittance over 8-12 um and 3-5 um at these ranges, and write <name>.csv, <name>.csv.sha256 and <name>.provenance.json with synthetic false and the run's inputs as the source; nothing in this container can run either code
